structured.feedback: The description is about 200 words in Markdown with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. Its claims come from the listing, and it leaves out the tightness and sizing complaints, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the loose feature/benefit split and the mediocre 3.9-star rating, which is a weak selling point.
